description_en: Retrieves the details of a snapshot
name: GetSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

Accessibility.description_en:
The visibility of the workspace. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.
PUBLIC: Visible to all users in the workspace
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见

CreationType.description_en:
The creation type of the snapshot. Valid values:
ManualCreated: Manual creation.
DeploymentAutoCreated: Automatic creation by the deployment service.
EvaluationAutoCreated: Automatic creation by an evaluation node
CreationType.description_zh:
快照的创建类型。取值：
ManualCreated：手动创建
DeploymentAutoCreated: 部署服务自动创建
EvaluationAutoCreated: 评测任务自动创建

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC, which follows the ISO 8601 standard
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time in UTC, which follows the ISO 8601 standard
GmtModifiedTime.description_zh: 最后修改时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间

SnapshotResourceId.description_en: The ID of the snapshot resource

SnapshotResourceType.description_en:
The resource type of the snapshot. Valid values:
Flow: Workflow
SnapshotResourceType.description_zh:
快照资源类型。取值：
Flow：工作流

SnapshotStoragePath.description_en: The OSS path where the snapshot source files are stored
SnapshotStoragePath.description_zh: 存储快照源文件的OSS路径

SnapshotUrl.description_en: The download URL of the snapshot

WorkDir.description_en: The OSS working directory where the snapshot is stored
WorkDir.description_zh: 存储快照的 OSS 工作目录

WorkspaceId.description_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 [ListWorkspaces]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html）

v1_parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
v1_parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
v1_parameters.name: WorkspaceId
